summary: U-BX Technology Ltd., a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K disclosing its election to rely on the home country practice exemption under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5615(a)(3). The company will follow Cayman Islands law in lieu of certain Nasdaq corporate governance requirements, specifically Rules 5635(a)-(d) regarding shareholder approval for acquisitions, change of control, equity compensation, and discounted issuances of 20%+ voting power. Cayman counsel Ogier certified the practice is permissible. This is a governance disclosure, not a corporate event. No deal terms, prices, or transaction mechanics are involved. Watch for any future shareholder challenges or Nasdaq compliance inquiries.
